summary.effect: Cut yourself (2d4 piercing) to make a homunculus bound to you. Your HP maximum drops while it lives; it shares a telepathic link with you. Only one at a time.

components.m: a clay crock, ash and mandrake root, with a drop of your blood

summary.effect: Immune to fire, resist cold, shed light. A creature that moves within 5 feet or ends its turn there takes 1d10 fire. Action: a 15-ft by 5-ft line, DEX save, 4d8 fire (half on success).
Immune to cold, resist fire. Ground within 10 feet is difficult terrain for others. Action: a 15-foot cone, CON save, 4d6 cold and speed halved; half damage on success.
Stone clads you. You resist bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical weapons, can move through earth, and can shake the ground within 15 feet as an action (DEX save or prone).
Ranged weapon attacks against you have disadvantage; fly speed 60 feet. Action: a 15-foot cube, CON save, 2d10 bludgeoning and pushed 10 feet; half damage and no push on success.
Trap a creature in an illusory cell. It takes 5d10 psychic either way. If it leaves the cell, it takes 10d10 psychic and the spell ends.
summary.fail: Restrained in the illusion and can’t see or hear past it.

summary.effect: You gain resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning and thunder damage. As a reaction when you take one of those types, gain immunity until the end of your next turn and the spell ends.
Teleport up to five creatures within range to spaces you choose within 120 feet. Unwilling creatures make a WIS save to resist.
Reaction when a humanoid dies within 60 feet: trap its soul for 8 hours. Up to six times, use it to regain 2d8 HP, ask it a question, gain advantage on a roll, or see a place it saw.

components.m: a tiny silver cage worth at least 100 gp

summary.effect: 50 temp HP, advantage on weapon attacks, +2d12 force on hits, armor, shield and weapon proficiency, STR and CON save proficiency, attack twice. No spellcasting. Afterward, DC 15 CON save or gain 1 exhaustion.

components.m: a few hairs from a bull

summary.effect: Seven motes of light orbit you. Use a bonus action to launch one at a creature within 120 feet as a ranged spell attack for 4d12 radiant. Each mote also sheds dim light.
summary.upcast: Two more motes per slot level above 7.

summary.effect: A creature with 100 HP or fewer, no save. Speed max 10 ft, disadvantage on attacks, checks and non-CON saves, and casting needs a CON save. It makes a CON save at the end of each turn to end it.

Raise a temple for 24 hours. Creatures of chosen types make a CHA save to enter, and subtract 1d4 from their rolls inside. Divination from outside is blocked. Healing spells inside add your WIS modifier.

components.m: a holy symbol worth at least 5 gp

summary.effect: A 10-foot-radius, 30-foot-high cyclone forms. Creatures in it make a DEX save and are flung up on a failure. You can shift it 30 feet as an action.

components.m: a piece of straw

summary.effect: Draw moisture out of a 30-foot cube. Creatures in it make a CON save. Plant creatures and water elementals save with disadvantage and take maximum damage; nonmagical plants wither.

components.m: a bit of sponge

summary.effect: A Huge shadowy dragon appears. Creatures that see it make a WIS save or are frightened. Bonus action: move it 60 feet and breathe a 60-foot cone (INT save, 7d6 of a chosen type, half on success).
Magical darkness fills a 60-foot radius. Light cannot lighten it. Creatures that start a turn in it make a WIS save and take psychic damage on a fail.

components.m: a drop of pitch mixed with a bit of mushroom

summary.effect: Raise a stone fortress for 7 days, staffed by 100 invisible servants. Cast it on the same spot every 7 days for a year and it becomes permanent.

components.m: a diamond worth at least 500 gp, consumed, and a miniature castle

summary.effect: You become immune to all damage until the spell ends.

components.m: a small piece of adamantine worth at least 500 gp, consumed

summary.effect: Transform up to ten creatures you can see into beasts of challenge rating up to their level or CR. Unwilling creatures make a WIS save. Each new form has its own stats.

components.m: a caterpillar cocoon

summary.effect: Choose up to ten creatures you can see. Each makes an INT save as its mind is blasted. A creature with Intelligence 2 or lower is unaffected.
summary.fail: 14d6 psychic and stunned; it makes an INT save at the end of each turn to end it.
